steps.text: Sign in to Netflix in a web browser.
Open the profile menu and choose Account.

steps.note: The names can change. Look for Membership and billing.
Check the end date the service shows. Payments stop on the date you set.

steps.text: Check your email for a confirmation from Netflix.
steps.note: If you pay through a partner, Apple, Google or a mobile carrier, cancel there. See the Apple App Store or Google Play guide.
